snippet.title: Blazblue Entropy Effect X - Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
The wait is over! BlazBlue Entropy Effect X available NOW globally on PlayStation 5, Nintendo Switch, and Xbox Series X|S! 🎮

Published by Astrolabe Games, developed by 91Act and supervised by Arc System Works, this Action Roguelite spin-off brings the iconic BlazBlue combat mechanics into a thrilling new dimension.

💿 Physical Deluxe Editions for PS5 and Nintendo Switch are also available starting today!

👇 GRAB YOUR COPY HERE 👇
